svg.title: Clawd, zonecraft's crab in a gas mask, in twelve scenes: by the campfire, playing the guitar, plotting a route, exploring the zone, throwing bolts, hunting artifacts, hunting mutants, looting a stash, trading, stories at the fire, fixing his gear, sleeping it off
